items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: Adolphus was a big heavy-set boy who looked something like Mingus, and he carried himself... He'd come around and look at us like....

ctx.x: I respected him. Did you know he wound up writing for Lawrence Welk?
Yeah! You told me that. Adolphus was a big heavy-set boy who looked something like Mingus, and he carried himself... He'd come around and look at us like....
Judo expert. Judo expert. He had a black belt in Judo.
